segmentos.texto: If you're new to smelling good, you don't need to spend a lot of money.
If you want to smell good at school or college.
Mont Blanc Explorer, Afnan Link Freedom and Rift Taif.
If you want to smell clean and citrusy.
Vilexa Aries, Jimmy Choo Man Ice and Tarathi Blue.
If you want to smell edible and yummy.
Mueller Amen, Liquid Brun and Mykonos Marbella.
If you want to smell mysterious and alluring.
Pagaraban, Black XS, Rehan Bontage and Ahmed Al Maghribi Udros.
And if you want to smell a little fruity.
Mykonos Dreamscape, Hawass Chrome and Daniel Desiree.
And if you want to smell manly.
J.Dot Leather, Pagaraban Pore Home and Isse Miyake, Le Ode Isse Pore Home Intense.
And that is a f***ing mouthful.
